[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Sera''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working for the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]]. He studied one of the company's captured [[Polydroxol]]s and created a [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] that could kill the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SS" />
